title: BBB Christmas Addition
description: A brand new qol experience, complete with new recipes, backporting, and villager trading.
body:
This modpack creates solutions for many of the issues addressed in the last server, I have added new forms of entertainment with custom music creation, art creation, and festive items.

The modpack now contains balancing, new weaponry in the form of backports from 1.21+ and Spartan Weaponry, with a sprinkle of new forms of destruction.

This mod also contains new world generation, in which improved vanilla structures can be found and explored for on new loot tables, as well as a backported [improved Trail Chambers]. Speaking of loot, explore and find various artifacts, treasures, and weaponry within the modpacks. All of which is a promise with Lootr!

Other fun features include, a drug mod, new building blocks and furnitiure, shop blocks, and many more quality of life mods!

Modpack is optimized with Sodium and Embeddium.
